answer: Rotating guardians change the recovery quorum on a schedule, and the vertex of the mechanism is that old guardians lose their power automatically when their term ends. The ocean of the design is that rotation is driven by a verifiable random beacon, so nobody can predict or manipulate the next set. A Sybil attacker cannot bribe a fixed set of guardians because the set keeps changing, and the river of the rotation means an attack must succeed inside one short term to matter.
